question: What type of aircraft did the Indian Air Force contingent include in Exercise INIOCHOS-25?

options.text: Su-30 MKI fighters, IL-78 aerial refuelers and C-17 transport aircraft

solution:
The correct answer is option 3,The Indian Air Force contingent in Exercise INIOCHOS-25 included Su-30 MKI fighters, IL-78 aerial refuelers, and C-17 transport aircraft.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Exercise INIOCHOS-25 is an annual multi-national air combat exercise hosted by Greece.
 
• The Indian Air Force participated in the exercise with a diverse contingent including **Su-30 MKI fighters**, **IL-78 aerial refuelers**, and **C-17 transport aircraft**.
 
• The Su-30 MKI is a twin-engine, multirole fighter aircraft designed for air superiority and ground attack missions.
 
• The IL-78 aerial refueler enhances the operational range of combat aircraft by enabling mid-air refueling.
 
• The C-17 Globemaster III is a heavy-lift transport aircraft capable of rapid strategic airlift of troops and cargo.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Su-30 MKI Fighter Aircraft**

 
 
• Developed by Russia's Sukhoi and customized by Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) for the Indian Air Force.
 
• Equipped with advanced avionics, long-range missiles, and precision-guided munitions.
 
• It is capable of air-to-air and air-to-ground combat missions.
 
 
 
• **IL-78 Aerial Refueler**
 
 
• The IL-78 is a Soviet-origin aerial refueling aircraft operated by the Indian Air Force.
 
• It significantly increases the operational reach of combat aircraft during missions.
 
• India has customized the IL-78 with refueling pods to meet its operational requirements.
 
 
 
• **C-17 Globemaster III**
 
 
• A strategic transport aircraft developed by Boeing, widely used for military logistics.
 
• It can carry heavy payloads, such as armored vehicles, troops, and humanitarian supplies.
 
• The Indian Air Force operates C-17s for rapid deployment and disaster relief missions.
 
 
 
• **Exercise INIOCHOS**
 
 
• Organized by the Hellenic Air Force, it is one of Europe’s premier air combat exercises.
 
• It involves participants from multiple countries, including NATO and non-NATO members.
 
• The exercise focuses on enhancing interoperability and combat readiness in realistic operational scenarios.
